reason: The tricks sound exactly like what I'd love to pull off at Friday dinner, and 99 ₪ isn't crazy for magic, but I'm not typing my card into some unknown website for an app that isn't even in the App Store or Google Play. I'd play with the free tricks and stop there.
objection: Paying by card on an unknown site, and installing something from the browser instead of the official store, feels risky - if it breaks or they vanish, I have no refund and no one to complain to.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to buy it through the App Store or Google Play (or a trusted payment like PayPal/Bit with a clear refund guarantee).
